findings.message: an irregular series must say whether each value is a state that holds until the next (a price, a balance) or a one-off event (a sale, a visit): the chart type depends on it, and the numbers cannot tell
findings.title: a time series is classified first: an irregular one states whether it holds states or events

source.shows: an irregular series that does not say whether it holds states or events: refused, since the type depends on it and the numbers cannot tell
